# Vocabulary

This list explains the terms used to describe the newspaper and its historical evidence. Each section links to its source JSON. Identifiers in backticks are the values used in the data.

Definitions and mappings are reproduced from those files. Where a label is absent, it is derived from the identifier; missing definitions and mappings are marked explicitly. A file without a version number is identified as unversioned.

EHRI is the European Holocaust Research Infrastructure; RiC-O is the International Council on Archives’ Records in Contexts Ontology. The [pinned standards](../standards/README.md) record the versions used. A local term (`pc:`) links to its declaration and gives the reason for using it. Mappings describe correspondence; they do not turn a disputed or unreviewed assertion into an established historical fact.

Some categories remain for reading older data. Their original definitions are retained; they do not authorise new conclusions about death or survival from residence alone. Deprecated terms remain listed with their replacements.

See the [released snapshots](../vocabulary/released/) and [approval history](vocabulary-approvals.md) for earlier versions and decisions. This generated data page uses [CC BY 4.0](../LICENSE-DATA); see [NOTICE](../NOTICE).

## People, events and evidence

Terms for describing people, their names and relationships, events, sources, and the evidence and review behind an assertion.

Source: [sourced-entities.json](../vocabulary/sourced-entities.json).

Version: 1.3.0.

Status: released.

Release date: 2026-10-26.

### Kinds of assertion

| Term and identifier | Definition | Mapping |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Birth (`birth`) | A sourced birth date; a birth place uses rico:hasBirthPlace independently, including when no date is known. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasBirthDate`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasBirthDate). |
| Death (`death`) | A sourced death date; a death place uses rico:hasDeathPlace independently, including when no date is known. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasDeathDate`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasDeathDate). |
| Residence (`residence`) | Residence in a place at a specified time. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasOrHadLocation`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasOrHadLocation). |
| Occupation (`occupation`) | An occupation, optionally bounded in time. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasOrHadOccupationOfType`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasOrHadOccupationOfType). |
| Office (`office`) | Holding a Position at a time; person occupiesOrOccupied the position, qualified through PositionHoldingRelation. | RiC-O: [`rico:occupiesOrOccupied`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#occupiesOrOccupied). Qualified through [`rico:PositionHoldingRelation`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#PositionHoldingRelation). |
| Membership (`membership`) | A person isOrWasMemberOf a group, inverse of group hasOrHadMember, qualified through MembershipRelation. | RiC-O: [`rico:isOrWasMemberOf`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#isOrWasMemberOf). Qualified through [`rico:MembershipRelation`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#MembershipRelation). |
| Education (`education`) | School attendance or education at a specified time. | Local term [`pc:fact_types_education`](../vocabulary/profile.ttl). TeachingRelation identifies teaching rather than establishing school attendance; retain attendance without asserting a teacher relationship. |
| Emigration (`emigration`) | A dated departure to live elsewhere; establishes neither death nor survival. | Local term [`pc:fact_types_emigration`](../vocabulary/profile.ttl). RiC-O MigrationRelation concerns instantiations, not migration of people. |
| Survival (`survival`) | Evidence that a person was alive at a specified time. | Local term [`pc:fact_types_survival`](../vocabulary/profile.ttl). No dedicated pinned relation expresses evidence of being alive at a time. |
| Parenthood (`parenthood`) | Parenthood of an unnamed child without inventing a person node; claims naming a relative use kinship, and links between identified people use relationships. Deprecated in 1.2.0: represent the child as a person and link each parent by parent\_of.<br>Deprecated in 1.2.0; replace with relationship\_types.parent\_of: Replace this fact with a parent\_of relation from each parent to the child as a person; use a supplied name when the source does not name the child. | Local term [`pc:fact_types_parenthood`](../vocabulary/profile.ttl). Preserves an unnamed child without inventing a person node for a child relation. |
| Ghetto role (`ghetto_role`) | A sourced ghetto activity not expressible as membership or office; use membership or office whenever those fit. | Local term [`pc:fact_types_ghetto_role`](../vocabulary/profile.ttl). No precise pinned counterpart for residual ghetto activities beyond membership or office. |
| Partisan service (`partisan_service`) | A sourced partisan activity beyond membership or office; use membership or office whenever those fit. | Local term [`pc:fact_types_partisan_service`](../vocabulary/profile.ttl). No precise pinned counterpart for residual partisan activities beyond membership or office. |
| Deportation (`deportation`) | A sourced forced removal at a date and place; event participation may link its event. | Local term [`pc:fact_types_deportation`](../vocabulary/profile.ttl). No dedicated pinned term captures forced removal of a person. |
| Burial (`burial`) | A sourced interment, optionally dated and placed; distinct from death. | Local term [`pc:fact_types_burial`](../vocabulary/profile.ttl). No dedicated pinned term captures interment of a person. |
| Commemoration (`commemoration`) | A sourced act of remembrance; event participation may link its event. | Local term [`pc:fact_types_commemoration`](../vocabulary/profile.ttl). No dedicated pinned term captures an act of remembrance of a person. |
| Event participation (`event_participation`) | Taking part in an event with an explicit mention role; weddings are events, not marriage facts. | RiC-O: [`rico:isOrWasParticipantIn`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#isOrWasParticipantIn). |
| Other (`other`) | An assertion awaiting an owner-approved type; requires a nonempty proposed\_type. | Local term [`pc:fact_types_other`](../vocabulary/profile.ttl). Retains an assertion pending owner approval of a specific type and mapping. |
| Kinship (`kinship`) | A source's statement that the person is related, in a stated way, to a named person who need not be identified | RiC-O: [`rico:hasFamilyAssociationWith`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasFamilyAssociationWith). Qualified through [`rico:FamilyRelation`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#FamilyRelation). |

### Main participants in an event

| Term and identifier | Definition | Mapping |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Baby (`baby`) | The baby at a birth.<br>Used for: `birth`. | Local term [`pc:part_baby`](../vocabulary/profile.ttl). The birth happens to this person; RiC-O has no baby part. Broader property: [`rico:affectsOrAffected`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#affectsOrAffected). |
| Parent (`parent`) | The parent at a birth.<br>Used for: `birth`. | Local term [`pc:part_parent`](../vocabulary/profile.ttl). A parent participates in a birth but is not the person born; RiC-O has no birth-parent part. Broader property: [`rico:hasOrHadParticipant`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasOrHadParticipant). |
| Bride (`bride`) | The bride at an engagement or a wedding.<br>Used for: `engagement`, `wedding`. | Local term [`pc:part_bride`](../vocabulary/profile.ttl). The engagement or wedding happens to the bride; RiC-O has no bride part. Broader property: [`rico:affectsOrAffected`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#affectsOrAffected). |
| Groom (`groom`) | The groom at an engagement or a wedding.<br>Used for: `engagement`, `wedding`. | Local term [`pc:part_groom`](../vocabulary/profile.ttl). The engagement or wedding happens to the groom; RiC-O has no groom part. Broader property: [`rico:affectsOrAffected`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#affectsOrAffected). |
| Boy (`boy`) | The boy at his bar mitzvah.<br>Used for: `bar_mitzvah`. | Local term [`pc:part_boy`](../vocabulary/profile.ttl). The bar mitzvah happens to this boy; RiC-O has no bar-mitzvah part. Broader property: [`rico:affectsOrAffected`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#affectsOrAffected). |
| Deceased (`deceased`) | The person who died, at a death.<br>Used for: `death`. | Local term [`pc:part_deceased`](../vocabulary/profile.ttl). The death happens to this person; RiC-O has no deceased part. Broader property: [`rico:affectsOrAffected`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#affectsOrAffected). |
| Remembered (`remembered`) | The person remembered, at a memorial.<br>Used for: `memorial`. | Local term [`pc:part_remembered`](../vocabulary/profile.ttl). The commemoration concerns this person without asserting another death; RiC-O has no remembered part. Broader property: [`rico:affectsOrAffected`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#affectsOrAffected). |

Concept type: [`rico:DocumentaryFormType`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#DocumentaryFormType). |

### Field mappings

These describe how fields correspond to standards; they are not additional controlled values.

| Term and identifier | Definition | Mapping |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Agent name (`agent_name`) | Names of persons, families and organisations use agent names. | RiC-O: [`rico:AgentName`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#AgentName). |
| Place name (`place_name`) | A shared place uses place names rather than agent names. | RiC-O: [`rico:PlaceName`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#PlaceName). |
| Place parent (`place_parent`) | A place's parent is a containing place. | RiC-O: [`rico:isOrWasPartOf`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#isOrWasPartOf). |
| Place coordinates (`place_coordinates`) | Coordinates of the place, latitude then longitude. | RiC-O: [`rico:geographicalCoordinates`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#geographicalCoordinates). |
| Place identifier (`place_identifier`) | A place's outside identifiers, each from a registered authority list, read on its own pages and carried only on that evidence. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasOrHadIdentifier`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasOrHadIdentifier). |
| Identifier (`identifier`) | One outside identifier of a place. | RiC-O: [`rico:Identifier`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#Identifier). |
| Identifier value (`identifier_value`) | The identifier as its authority writes it. | RiC-O: [`rico:textualValue`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#textualValue). |
| Identifier authority (`identifier_authority`) | The registered source an identifier comes from names its identifier type; an export makes one identifier type for each such source. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasIdentifierType`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasIdentifierType). |
| Identifier reading (`identifier_reading`) | Who added an identifier, and the day it was read on its authority's own pages. | Local term [`pc:site_identifier_reading`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). RiC-O's isEvidencedBy has Relation as its domain, and an Identifier is an Appellation, so the reading that justifies an identifier has no pinned term. |
| Source host (`source_host`) | A registered source's host: every address cited from it, or given for an identifier of it, is on that host or a subdomain of it. | Local term [`pc:site_source_host`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). Neither EHRI nor RiC-O 1.1 records the web host a source's records are served from. |
| Fact place relation (`fact_place_relation`) | A sourced fact with a place, with its citations and its evidence confidence, is a place relation from the place to the fact's subject; one per source's statement, never merged. | RiC-O: [`rico:PlaceRelation`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#PlaceRelation). |
| Fact certainty (`fact_certainty`) | A fact's evidence confidence is the certainty of the relation its statement maps to. | RiC-O: [`rico:relationCertainty`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#relationCertainty). |
| Death place shortcut (`death_place_shortcut`) | Written only in an export, from the person's preferred accepted death statement; never stored, and never from a disputed or proposed one. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasDeathPlace`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasDeathPlace). |
| Death date shortcut (`death_date_shortcut`) | Written only in an export, from the person's preferred accepted death statement; never stored, and never from a disputed or proposed one. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasDeathDate`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasDeathDate). |
| Family membership (`family_membership`) | A sourced membership fact with family\_id names the family as the group. | RiC-O: [`rico:isOrWasMemberOf`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#isOrWasMemberOf). Qualified through [`rico:MembershipRelation`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#MembershipRelation). |
| Life event main person (`life_event_main_person`) | A main person participates in the life event. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasOrHadParticipant`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasOrHadParticipant). |
| Display permission (`display_permission`) | The shown field retains who allowed a relative to be displayed and when. | Local term [`pc:site_display_permission`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). Neither EHRI nor RiC-O expresses the site's permission to display a relative under its living-person rule. |
| Content item (`content_item`) | A content item is a record resource. | EHRI: [`ehri:RecordResource`](http://lod.ehri-project-test.eu/ontology#RecordResource). |
| Section (`section`) | A section groups content items under a printed heading. | EHRI: [`ehri:RecordSet`](http://lod.ehri-project-test.eu/ontology#RecordSet). |
| Section membership (`section_membership`) | A section includes its content items. | RiC-O: [`rico:includesOrIncluded`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#includesOrIncluded). |
| Title (`title`) | Both printed and supplied titles use Title nodes. | RiC-O: [`rico:Title`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#Title). |
| Has title (`has_title`) | Connect a content item or section to either title. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasOrHadTitle`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasOrHadTitle). |
| Title type (`title_type`) | A Title uses one of the declared title type concepts. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasTitleType`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasTitleType). |
| Title text (`title_text`) | The words of a title. | RiC-O: [`rico:textualValue`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#textualValue). |
| Subtype (`subtype`) | Connect a content item to its documentary form concept. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasDocumentaryFormType`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasDocumentaryFormType). |
| Subject (`subject`) | Connect a content item to what it is about. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasOrHadSubject`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasOrHadSubject). |
| Person (`person`) | A person in the shared record. | EHRI: [`ehri:Person`](http://lod.ehri-project-test.eu/ontology#Person). |
| Family (`family`) | A family in the shared record. | EHRI: [`ehri:Family`](http://lod.ehri-project-test.eu/ontology#Family). |
| Place (`place`) | A place without a more specific EHRI class. | RiC-O: [`rico:Place`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#Place). |
| City (`city`) | A city in the shared record. | EHRI: [`ehri:City`](http://lod.ehri-project-test.eu/ontology#City). |
| Region (`region`) | A region in the shared record. | EHRI: [`ehri:Region`](http://lod.ehri-project-test.eu/ontology#Region). |
| Country (`country`) | A country in the shared record. | EHRI: [`ehri:Country`](http://lod.ehri-project-test.eu/ontology#Country). |
| Organization (`organization`) | An organisation in the shared record. | EHRI: [`ehri:CorporateBody`](http://lod.ehri-project-test.eu/ontology#CorporateBody). |
| Life event (`life_event`) | A life event with persons, evidenced by newspaper content items or records alone. | RiC-O: [`rico:Event`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#Event). |
| Source (`source`) | A source used by a fact or relation. | EHRI: [`ehri:RecordResource`](http://lod.ehri-project-test.eu/ontology#RecordResource). |
| Relation (`relation`) | A relation reuses the production kinship or other/proposed\_type payload; a released relationship type selects the specific qualification class. | RiC-O: [`rico:Relation`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#Relation). |
| Fact source (`fact_source`) | A qualified fact or relation cites the record resources that evidence it, not its source endpoint. | RiC-O: [`rico:isEvidencedBy`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#isEvidencedBy). |
| Printed address (`printed_address`) | The picture key, pixel box and printed words locate evidence independently of changing content item numbers. | Local term [`pc:site_printed_address`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). Neither EHRI nor RiC-O defines an address combining a picture key, native pixel box and the words read there. |
| Text basis (`text_basis`) | Exact source text and printed addresses preserve the basis of a translation or supplied title, including after a rereading. | Local term [`pc:site_text_basis`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). EHRI and RiC-O source relations do not preserve the exact text and printed addresses used for a particular reading. |
| Translation (`translation`) | An attributed English rendering of printed text pinned to the exact text it was made from. | Local term [`pc:site_translation`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). Neither EHRI nor RiC-O has a term combining a translation with the exact source reading and its printed addresses. |
| Authorship (`authorship`) | Records whether a person or a model wrote a supplied title or translation, reusing production attribution. | Local term [`pc:site_authorship`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). RiC-O AuthorshipRelation describes an author relation, not the site's attribution value with person-or-model kind, writer and day. |
| Mention (`mention`) | A mention joins a shared person to a content item with roles, pinned to located words or whole printed regions when the words are unlocated; a mention alone does not assert that the person is its subject. | Local term [`pc:site_mention`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). RiC-O subject relations do not express a named person's printed occurrence, address and role without asserting that the content item is about them. |
| Mention address grain (`mention_address_grain`) | IssueMention.address\_grain distinguishes words with a located printed name from regions with a null printed name and exact whole-region addresses. | Local term [`pc:site_mention_address_grain`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). Neither EHRI 0.2.0 nor its RiC-O 1.1 version defines whether a mention locates name words or only whole printed regions. |
| Shared record (`shared_record`) | One storage document joins the production sourced facts, sources and identities across issues. | Local term [`pc:site_shared_record`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). EHRI RecordSet groups record resources; it does not describe this application's single storage file combining identities, sourced facts and relations. |
| Fact subject (`fact_subject`) | Identifies whose statement a production fact is, including a family or relation. | Local term [`pc:site_fact_subject`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). RiC-O relation endpoints do not specify the subject\_id field attaching a production fact to a person, family or relation. |
| Fact representation (`fact_representation`) | Distinguishes structured facts, prose and image paths without approving their publication. | Local term [`pc:site_fact_representation`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). Neither EHRI nor RiC-O defines this site's distinction between a structured fact, retained prose and an image path. |
| Standing (`standing`) | Proposed is accepted plus pending review; accepted is accepted plus approved review; doubted is disputed; rejected is rejected. Attribution and review retain who said so. | Local term [`pc:site_standing`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). RiC-O relationState does not define this site's combinations of claim status and review or who set them. |
| Site copy (`site_copy`) | Full text, block breaks and block references are copies for the site, rebuilt from the physical source. | Local term [`pc:site_site_copy`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). Neither EHRI nor RiC-O defines the rebuilt full-text copies, Unicode offsets and block references used by this site. |
| Site documents (`site_documents`) | Groups the four issue documents for reference validation without copying shared persons into them. | Local term [`pc:site_site_documents`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). EHRI RecordSet describes a collection, not this application's four-document value for validating joins. |
| English check (`english_check`) | The checked\_against value records an independent later check of one exact English field against one exact reading. | RiC-O: [`rico:Activity`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#Activity). |
| English check agent (`english_check_agent`) | The checking person or software agent named by checked\_against.attribution. | EHRI: [`ehri:Agent`](http://lod.ehri-project-test.eu/ontology#Agent). |
| English check judgement (`english_check_judgement`) | The retained judgement record referenced by checked\_against.judgement\_id. | RiC-O: [`rico:Record`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#Record). |
| Checked against text (`checked_against_text`) | Binds an English field to the exact checked reading and judgement. | Local term [`pc:site_checked_against_text`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). Neither pinned ontology defines this application-specific field-level digest binding. |
| Reading sha256 (`reading_sha256`) | SHA-256 of the exact current reading UTF-8 bytes. | Local term [`pc:site_reading_sha256`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). Neither pinned ontology specifies the digest of the exact reading in a field-level check. |
| English sha256 (`english_sha256`) | SHA-256 of the exact English field UTF-8 bytes. | Local term [`pc:site_english_sha256`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). Neither pinned ontology specifies the digest of the exact English field in a later check. |
| Judgement sha256 (`judgement_sha256`) | SHA-256 of the exact retained judgement file bytes. | Local term [`pc:site_judgement_sha256`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). Neither pinned ontology binds a field-level check to the exact retained judgement file bytes. |
| Event type (`event_type`) | The one kind of a shared life event. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasEventType`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasEventType). |
| Event date (`event_date`) | A printed event date, a qualified first report, or the date of the preferred record statement. | RiC-O: [`rico:Date`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#Date). |
| Event date printed (`event_date_printed`) | The event date words with their printed calendar. | RiC-O: [`rico:expressedDate`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#expressedDate). |
| Event date normalized (`event_date_normalized`) | An ISO value only for a printed Gregorian event date. | RiC-O: [`rico:normalizedDateValue`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#normalizedDateValue). |
| Event date qualifier (`event_date_qualifier`) | Reported in qualifies an issue date; it never bounds the happening. | RiC-O: [`rico:dateQualifier`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#dateQualifier). |
| Person name (`person_name`) | Connect a person to an AgentName, including a supplied description. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasOrHadAgentName`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasOrHadAgentName). |
| Agent name (`agent_name`) | A printed or supplied name of a person. | RiC-O: [`rico:AgentName`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#AgentName). |
| Event evidence basis (`event_evidence_basis`) | Records alone support a death; no issue selects it. | Local term [`pc:site_event_evidence_basis`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). Neither pinned ontology records this application-specific absence of newspaper evidence. |
| Event record date (`event_record_date`) | Select the accepted death fact whose date and place describe the event; retain all other statements. | Local term [`pc:site_event_record_date`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). Neither pinned ontology chooses a preferred source statement for this application; the referenced date uses the existing RiC-O Date mapping. |
| Holder institution (`holder_institution`) | An institutional source holder. | EHRI: [`ehri:Institution`](http://lod.ehri-project-test.eu/ontology#Institution). |
| Holder family (`holder_family`) | A family holding papers. | EHRI: [`ehri:Family`](http://lod.ehri-project-test.eu/ontology#Family). |
| Holder private (`holder_private`) | A private person holding papers; the name is never published. | RiC-O: [`rico:Person`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#Person). |
| Holder name (`holder_name`) | The name and display name of a holder. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasOrHadName`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasOrHadName). |
| Holder identifier (`holder_identifier`) | Outside holder identifiers have the same evidence as place identifiers. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasOrHadIdentifier`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasOrHadIdentifier). |
| Source holder (`source_holder`) | The holder identified by holder\_id. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasOrHadHolder`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasOrHadHolder). |
| Source copy (`source_copy`) | A copy names its original through derived\_from. | EHRI: [`ehri:isCopyOf`](http://lod.ehri-project-test.eu/ontology#isCopyOf). |
| Source transcription (`source_transcription`) | A transcription describes its original; it is not a copy. | RiC-O: [`rico:describesOrDescribed`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#describesOrDescribed). |
| Source reference code (`source_reference_code`) | The holder reference on a source or citation. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasOrHadIdentifier`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasOrHadIdentifier). |
| Source language (`source_language`) | BCP 47 languages of a record, or of its quoted translation. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasOrHadLanguage`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasOrHadLanguage). |
| Citation record type (`citation_record_type`) | The documentary form named by the holding institution. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasDocumentaryFormType`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasDocumentaryFormType). |
| Source dated (`source_dated`) | The document own date, separate from publication and consultation. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasCreationDate`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasCreationDate). |
| Source display (`source_display`) | A source short name for display. | Local term [`pc:site_source_display`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). Neither standard specifies the site voice for crediting a source. |
| Source privacy (`source_privacy`) | A private document and attributed permission to quote it. | Local term [`pc:site_source_privacy`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). Neither standard defines this project publication policy. |
| Citation public note (`citation_public_note`) | Reviewed editorial words distinct from the record quote. | Local term [`pc:site_citation_public_note`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). Neither standard encodes this project public/private note boundary. |
| Citation locator (`citation_locator`) | Internal provenance, never an archive record id. | Local term [`pc:site_citation_locator`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). Neither standard specifies pointers into this project files. |
| Source quote condition (`source_quote_condition`) | The owner's condition on a private source's cleared quotes: shown only where no other record states the same. | Local term [`pc:site_source_quote_condition`](../vocabulary/site-content.profile.ttl). Neither pinned ontology encodes this project's publication condition. |

<a id="reading-status"></a>

## Reading and correction

States recording how a transcription or English rendering was read, checked or corrected.

Source: [reading-status.json](../vocabulary/reading-status.json).

Version: unversioned (no version declared in the JSON).

### Field and reading states

| Term and identifier | Definition | Mapping |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Reading status (`reading_status`) | Optional per-field reading provenance. Null is unrecorded. A session check may cover particular words only. | Local term [`pc:site_reading_status`](../vocabulary/reading-status.profile.ttl). Neither EHRI 0.2.0 nor its imported RiC-O 1.1 encodes independent text and English machine, AI-session-checked or human-corrected states; history and productionTechnique do not express these field-level distinctions. |
| Machine (`machine`) | A machine reading without a recorded qualifying check. | Local term [`pc:site_reading_machine`](../vocabulary/reading-status.profile.ttl). Application-specific reading provenance state, not a state defined in either pinned ontology. |
| Session checked (`session_checked`) | An AI session checked or corrected the field, possibly particular words only. | Local term [`pc:site_reading_session_checked`](../vocabulary/reading-status.profile.ttl). Application-specific reading provenance state, not a state defined in either pinned ontology. |
| Person corrected (`person_corrected`) | A recorded human author corrected the field; AI drafts and approvals alone do not qualify. | Local term [`pc:site_reading_person_corrected`](../vocabulary/reading-status.profile.ttl). Application-specific reading provenance state, not a state defined in either pinned ontology. |

<a id="identifiers"></a>

## Retained identifiers

Terms for keeping an old identifier when records are merged.

Source: [identifiers.json](../vocabulary/identifiers.json).

Version: unversioned (no version declared in the JSON).

### Kinds of identifier

| Term and identifier | Definition | Mapping |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Old identifier (`old_identifier`) | A merged identifier retained permanently on the surviving record, with the registered merge source, reading day and attribution. It redirects to the surviving id and is never reused. | Local term [`pc:old_identifier`](../vocabulary/identifiers.profile.ttl). RiC-O IdentifierType gives old identifier as an example but does not mint that value; this concept types our retained merged identifiers. |

<a id="media"></a>

## Images, recordings and documents

Field mappings for describing a source copy, its rights, access and presentation. These are field descriptions, not a release of new controlled values.

Source: [media.json](../vocabulary/media.json).

Version: unversioned (no version declared in the JSON).

Status: local.

### Field mappings

These describe how fields correspond to standards; they are not additional controlled values.

| Term and identifier | Definition | Mapping |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Medium (`medium`) | One held or linked instantiation of a registered source. | RiC-O: [`rico:Instantiation`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#Instantiation). |
| Media source (`media_source`) | Media.source\_id names the record instantiated, never the person depicted. | RiC-O: [`rico:isOrWasInstantiationOf`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#isOrWasInstantiationOf). |
| Source subjects (`source_subjects`) | Source.subjects names persons, places or events depicted or spoken of. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasOrHadSubject`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasOrHadSubject). |
| Media conditions of use (`media_conditions_of_use`) | The holder's terms as written, without inferred permission. | RiC-O: [`rico:conditionsOfUse`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#conditionsOfUse). |
| Media width (`media_width`) | Master width in display pixels, after orientation. | RiC-O: [`rico:width`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#width). |
| Media height (`media_height`) | Master height in display pixels, after orientation. | RiC-O: [`rico:height`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#height). |
| Media kind (`media_kind`) | An instantiation uses one of our four local RepresentationType concepts: image, audio, video, document. | RiC-O: [`rico:hasRepresentationType`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#hasRepresentationType). |
| Media caption (`media_caption`) | Our page caption, with a separate human review. | Local term [`pc:media_caption`](../vocabulary/media.profile.ttl). The application records caption language and review day/role; the pinned ontologies do not define that composite. |
| Media alt (`media_alt`) | Our screen-reader description, required for images, with a separate human review. | Local term [`pc:media_alt`](../vocabulary/media.profile.ttl). Neither pinned ontology defines the application's accessibility text and its human review. |
| Media duration (`media_duration`) | Master duration in seconds. | Local term [`pc:media_duration`](../vocabulary/media.profile.ttl). This design claims no pinned duration mapping; seconds remain a local display measurement. |
| Media rights (`media_rights`) | An applicable rightsstatements.org or Creative Commons URI. | Local term [`pc:media_rights`](../vocabulary/media.profile.ttl). This URI identifies terms, not the owner's permission to publish this particular copy. |
| Media clearance (`media_clearance`) | Public clearance day and closed role; contributor identity and consent evidence are private. | Local term [`pc:media_clearance`](../vocabulary/media.profile.ttl). Rights and text review cannot stand for the owner's permission to derive or serve a private copy. |
| Media link (`media_link`) | A holder-host page for audio or video. | Local term [`pc:media_link`](../vocabulary/media.profile.ttl). This link is a referral to the holder's page, not a served media file or clearance. |
| Media master (`media_master`) | A separate private bucket name, content key, SHA-256, MIME, byte count and dated fixity check. | Local term [`pc:media_master`](../vocabulary/media.profile.ttl). Neither pinned ontology defines this application's content-addressed private storage descriptor; it never enters the public projection. |
| Media derived (`media_derived`) | Content-hashed WebP addresses, actual dimensions and the sole process resize at the exported widths. | Local term [`pc:media_derived`](../vocabulary/media.profile.ttl). Neither pinned ontology defines this application's responsive WebP delivery manifest. |
| Media conditions of access (`media_conditions_of_access`) | The holder's access terms, verbatim. | RiC-O: [`rico:conditionsOfAccess`](https://www.ica.org/standards/RiC/ontology#conditionsOfAccess). |
| Media credit (`media_credit`) | The holder or family's credit, verbatim. | Local term [`pc:media_credit`](../vocabulary/media.profile.ttl). IIIF requiredStatement is a future delivery crosswalk; no IIIF ontology is pinned here. |
| Media depicted (`media_depicted`) | Identified or unidentified people, human identification basis and master pixel regions. | Local term [`pc:media_depicted`](../vocabulary/media.profile.ttl). Source subjects use RiC-O; this per-picture identification and rectangle are application data. |
| Media shows unidentified (`media_shows_unidentified`) | An explicit declaration that the picture includes unidentified people. | Local term [`pc:media_shows_unidentified`](../vocabulary/media.profile.ttl). This publication safeguard is local, not a record subject inference. |
| Media inscription (`media_inscription`) | The object's own words with language and human review. | Local term [`pc:media_inscription`](../vocabulary/media.profile.ttl). The text and review composite is local; the object remains the cited record. |
| Media family words (`media_family_words`) | A public citation of the family's words, quote language and page or recorded part. | Local term [`pc:media_family_words`](../vocabulary/media.profile.ttl). This is a Citation subset, not a second caption or an invented source. |
| Media transcript (`media_transcript`) | Full document text with language and review. | Local term [`pc:media_transcript`](../vocabulary/media.profile.ttl). The transcript text and its review are application data, not an inferred RiC-O relationship. |
| Media consent (`media_consent`) | Private basis, giver, scope, evidence reference and withdrawal day. | Local term [`pc:media_consent`](../vocabulary/media.profile.ttl). Permission evidence is private and must not be represented as public creator or holder metadata. |
| Media withdrawn (`media_withdrawn`) | A retained withdrawal day and closed reason, with no served files. | Local term [`pc:media_withdrawn`](../vocabulary/media.profile.ttl). Withdrawal is a publication state; it does not delete the cited record. |
| Media portrait (`media_portrait`) | A person's reviewed medium and crop region in oriented master pixels. | Local term [`pc:media_portrait`](../vocabulary/media.profile.ttl). This is a presentation selection; it does not change the photograph or its source. |
| Source made by (`source_made_by`) | Family, studio, institution, perpetrator or unknown origin classification. | Local term [`pc:source_made_by`](../vocabulary/media.profile.ttl). A category is not a creator Agent, so made\_by must not be asserted as rico:hasCreator. |

<a id="citation-requirements"></a>

## Citation guidance

Advisory requirements for locating and quoting evidence for different kinds of source. This is a rules table, not a separate list of approved terms.

Source: [citation-requirements.json](../vocabulary/citation-requirements.json).

Version: unversioned (no version declared in the JSON).

The [source table](../vocabulary/citation-requirements.json) records required citation details and alternatives. Proposed source kinds in that table are not released vocabulary. Approved source kinds and their definitions appear under “Kinds of source” above.
